title: Query trace availability
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, let $n$ be a natural number, and let a finite decision tree have its queries restricted to an available set $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For every input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, each coordinate in the tree's query trace belongs to $A$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with available coordinate set A
An input assigning an element of Ω to each of the n coordinates
